Varun Alagh
Co-Founder, Honasa Consumer Limited – Mamaearth
Varun Alagh faced a challenge when they couldn't find toxin-free baby products in India, leading them to take matters into their own hands.
Leveraging Varun's experience in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry and Ghazal's entrepreneurial spirit, the couple decided to establish a company specializing in natural toxin-free baby care products adhering to international standards.
In 2016, this vision came to life with the birth of Honasa Consumer, operating under the brand name Mamaearth. Both Varun and Ghazal are first-generation entrepreneurs, driven by a forward-looking mindset. Under their leadership, Mamaearth expanded its product range from six baby care items to an impressive array of 140 personal care products.
Over time, Honasa also completed three acquisitions and developed its own brand portfolio. In the recent past, the company embraced offline distribution by collaborating with multi-brand retail outlets and establishing exclusive stores, effectively catering to customers in both online and offline markets.
Their future plans involve expanding the offline business to encompass 100,000 outlets across 100 cities in India.

Home entrepreneur Life Story of Ghazal Alagh, Cofounder of Mamaearth
Life Story of Ghazal Alagh, Cofounder of Mamaearth
Her name is Ghazal Alagh she is building a successful venture with her husband.
Has appeared as a shark (investor/judge) on Shark Tank Season 1. She is the co-founder of Mamaearth, a toxin-free baby care, and beauty skin care brand.
Let us know about the entrepreneurial journey of Ghazal Alagh…
Mamaarth's Ghazal is the only chief uncle and Varun is the only chief dad.
Honasa Company launched its second brand ‘The Derma Co’ which provides hair and skin care products. She launched her third brand ‘Aqualogica’ in November 2021, which is based on skincare products.
Who is working together to take their company to new heights?
Read This Also: Life story of India's second richest self-made female billionaire Falguni Nayar
Founding of Mamaearth
Agastya Alagh, son of Ghazal Alagh and Varun Alagh, was suffering from a skin disease called eczema at the time of birth.
Her son was allergic to chemical products available in the market, due to which her body would turn red. The doctor advised to use chemical-free baby care products.
However it became difficult to find natural skincare products for my son. Now no compromise could be made with the health of the son.
That's why he used to import such products from abroad. Which were very expensive and not easily available. Many times he would request friends and relatives who had gone abroad to get natural products for his children.
Due to this problem of his son, she got the idea of making natural childcare and skincare products.
She understood that many other children and their parents might be facing this problem. Because naturally derived care products were not visible anywhere in India. For that, there was dependence on foreign companies only.
Ghazal Alagh did the research and found out why this product is not suitable for children.
The foundation of ‘Mamaarth’ was laid by Ghazal Alagh along with her husband in the year 2015.
Before starting her brand, Ghazal Alagh got around 700 women to test the product on their children. First took reviews from all the women and then launched their product in the market properly.
In 2016, she founded ‘Mamaarth’ with her husband.
She branded her products vigorously through social media and YouTube. She also got her brand promoted by big YouTubers.
In 2018, Bollywood actress Shilpa Shetty became an investor in 'Mamaarth'. She is the brand ambassador of ‘Mamaarth’. Sara Ali Khan became the ambassador of hair and care products.
Mamaarth serves more than 50 lakh customers in approximately 500 cities.
Investing in many companies also helped Ghazal Alagh increase his net worth.
As a judge on Shark Tank India Season 1, she invested in many startups.
Shark Tank India 2021 was launched in December. It is an adaptation of the popular American reality show Shark Tank.

How Safe is Mam Earth for my baby?
MamaEarth, – I did not pick this brand just like that. I read about ingredients, Safety measures, formulation, and Testing. The website says the products of Mama Earth are safe and Natural.

These products are safe, Non Allergic, Ecofreindly and Non Toxic, Hence Safe for my baby.

Varun Alagh is the Co-Founder and Chief Dad of Honasa Consumer Private Limited , which established its first-ever baby nourishing brand, Mamaearth, in November 2016. The company is based in Gurugram, India. Mamaearth is declared Asia's first MadeSafe-certified brand.
Varun founded the toxin-free baby, beauty, hair, face, and body care brand Mamaearth with his wife, Ghazal Alagh , who plays the major role of Chief Mama at the company. As of January 6, 2025, Mamaearth's market value is $928 million, with a stock price of $2.86 and 325 million shares.
Varun Alagh - Biography
Mamaearth Company Owners - Varun Alagh and Ghazal Alagh Mamaearth Company Owners - Varun Alagh and Ghazal Alagh
He is married to Ghazal Alagh , who is the Co-founder and Chief Mama of Mamaearth . She looks after the product development, content, and community management of the company. Before that, she had worked in the IT corporate world.
Varun Alagh - Professional Life and Journey So Far!
He worked with the Coca-Cola company for three years and seven months, i.e., from May 2013 to November 2016. He excelled in building brand value for nine long years by working with several renowned companies.
He founded Mamaearth in November 2016, providing a range of toxin-free baby skincare products.
Both Varun Alagh and Ghazal Alagh had a suitable background in handling such a brand professionally, which was eventually developed due to personal reasons.
When Varun and Ghazal realized that their newborn son, Agastya, had a skin-borne disease called eczema, his skin was allergic to a lot of substances and turned red and itchy when exposed to such chemicals. The couple had to look for toxin-free baby care products in the market. Varun Alagh's net worth stands at $14.40 Million.
Business Idea
The company exists to provide honest, natural, and safe products. Mamaearth is the first brand of the company that focuses on reducing parenting stress by providing solutions to parent and baby problems in the form of safe, international standard products.
The Directors of the company include Varun Alagh , Ghazal Alagh, Vettakkorumakankav Siva, Subramaniam Sita, Rahul Chowdhri, and Ishan Mittal. The company started with a combined investment of Rs 90 lakh by Varun, Ghazal, and a few of the angel investors .
Co-Founder of Mamaearth
Mamaearth Logo Mamaearth Logo
Varun serves as Mamaearth's Co-Founder and Chief Dad, headquartered in Gurugram, India.
He founded the company in November 2016, primarily as a babycare products brand, which saw good growth and thereby expanded to several other categories, including - Beauty, Hair, Face, and Body care, and currently targets a range of audiences, including babies, moms to be, and men above the age of 15 years too.
Within two years of the startup, the company got a retail turnover of Rs 20 crore. By 2020, Mamaearth's net worth was over Rs 100 Crore. The company eventually turned out to be the first unicorn in India in 2022 by raising $52 million on January 1, 2022.
